ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Adds one new pull_request-only, deliberately non-gate step to ci.yml (Check-body suspects, advisory, non-blocking) in the same job as the Keystone AC gate and P3.7 feeder checks (#702, #711): reads the same regenerated traceability manifest and real git history, but its own CLI (check_test_body_suspects.py) returns exit 0 unconditionally, so it can never become a merge blocker even by accident -- strictly weaker trust posture than its siblings, never stronger. Provenance for the bundling decision is trg-d03a239d (the originally cited card id could not be found in the tracked triage store, so this run filed a replacement at its own finalization).
